```yaml
name: ADR Backlog Audit

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'docs/adr/**'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'docs/adr/**'

jobs:
  audit-adr-backlog:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Verify ADR-044 and ADR-045 Closure
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check for ADR-044 (Webhook)
        run: |
          echo "Checking for ADR-044..."
          if [ ! -f "docs/adr/044-webhook-outbound-http-integration.md" ]; then
            echo "::error::ADR-044 file not found. Please add docs/adr/044-webhook-outbound-http-integration.md"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "ADR-044 found."

      - name: Check for ADR-045 (PS=1 Parsing)
        run: |
          echo "Checking for ADR-045..."
          if [ ! -f "docs/adr/045-ps1-print-summary-parsing.md" ]; then
            echo "::error::ADR-045 file not found. Please add docs/adr/045-ps1-print-summary-parsing.md"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "ADR-045 found."

      - name: Validate ADR-044 Content
        run: |
          echo "Validating ADR-044 content..."
          FILE="docs/adr/044-webhook-outbound-http-integration.md"
          grep -q "webhook.ino" "$FILE" || { echo "::error::ADR-044 must reference webhook.ino"; exit 1; }
          grep -q "isLocalUrl" "$FILE" || { echo "::error::ADR-044 must reference isLocalUrl"; exit 1; }
          grep -q "StatusFlags" "$FILE" || { echo "::error::ADR-044 must reference StatusFlags"; exit 1; }
          echo "ADR-044 content valid."

      - name: Validate ADR-045 Content
        run: |
          echo "Validating ADR-045 content..."
          FILE="docs/adr/045-ps1-print-summary-parsing.md"
          grep -q "processPSSummary" "$FILE" || { echo "::error::ADR-045 must reference processPSSummary"; exit 1; }
          grep -q "PSSUMMARY_MSGIDS" "$FILE" || { echo "::error::ADR-045 must reference PSSUMMARY_MSGIDS"; exit 1; }
          grep -q "decodeAndPublishOTValue" "$FILE" || { echo "::error::ADR-045 must reference decodeAndPublishOTValue"; exit 1; }
          echo "ADR-045 content valid."

      - name: Summary
        run: |
          echo "ADR Backlog Audit Complete."
          echo "ADR-044: Webhook Outbound HTTP Integration - Closed"
          echo "ADR-045: PS=1 Print Summary Parsing - Closed"
```
